records.quote: The "cargo" molecules loaded on the surface of a cell in order to avoid premature clearance and improve targeted delivery.

records.claim: Cell penetrating peptides are small peptides that facilitate cellular uptake of a variety of agents, going from small molecules to whole NMs.
records.quote: Small peptides that facilitate cellular uptake of a variety of agents, going from small molecules to whole NMs.

records.claim: Camptothecin is a natural compound that potently inhibits DNA-topoisomerase-I, but its clinical use has remained limited due to low solubility.
records.quote: A natural compound isolated from specific trees (Camptotheca acuminata Decne) and potently inhibits DNA-topoisomerase-I. Because of its low solubility, its clinical use has remained limited

records.claim: Cancer stem cells are a small subpopulation of tumor cells that possess many features typically associated with stem cells, including self-renewal, and are often associated with higher therapeutic resistance and tumor relapse.
records.quote: A small subpopulation of tumor cells that possess many features typically associated with stem cells, including self-renewal. These cells are often associated with higher therapeutic resistance and tumor relapse.

records.claim: A drug delivery system is any type of system (commonly a nanoparticle) that is used as a vessel to transport drugs from the site of administration to its intended target site and hereby prevents premature clearance or off-target effects.
records.quote: Any type of system (commonly a nanoparticle) that is used as a vessel to transport drugs from the site of administration to its intended target site and hereby prevents premature clearance or off-target effects.

records.claim: Doxorubicin is a commonly used chemotherapeutic agent, clinically used for breast metastases treatment.
records.quote: Commonly used chemotherapeutic agent, clinically used for breast metastases treatment.

records.claim: A doxorubicin prodrug is an alternative form of doxorubicin which only becomes therapeutically active upon biological or chemical processing.
records.quote: An alternative form of doxorubicin which only becomes therapeutically active upon biological or chemical processing.

records.claim: Docetaxel is a cytostatic chemotherapeutic agent used in breast, colorectal, lung, ovarian, prostate, liver, renal, gastric, and head and neck cancers and melanoma.
records.quote: Similar to PTX, a cytostatic chemotherapeutic agent used in breast, colorectal, lung, ovarian, prostate, liver, renal, gastric, and head and neck cancers and melanoma

records.claim: The extracellular matrix is a dense fibrous network that provides structure and support to cells, and in tumors it is often particularly dense and thick, acting as a barrier for delivery.
records.quote: A dense fibrous network that provides structure and support to cells. In tumors, the ECM is often particularly dense and thick and can be seen as a barrier for delivery.

records.claim: Epidermal growth factor is a protein stimulating cell growth and differentiation by binding to its receptor (EGFR), and is therefore used as a peptide for targeted NM delivery.
records.quote: A protein stimulating cell growth and differentiation by binding to its receptor (EGFR). It is therefore used as a peptide for targeted NM delivery.

records.claim: The epidermal growth factor receptor is a receptor commonly overexpressed by tumor cells, often targeted by NMs for targeted delivery, and therapeutically targeted by clinically approved formulations (cetuximab and panitumumab).
records.quote: A receptor commonly overexpressed by tumor cells. It is often targeted by NMs for targeted delivery. It is also therapeutically targeted by clinically approved formulations (cetuximab and panitumumab).

records.claim: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is the process by which cells go from an epithelial to a more mesenchymal form, linked in cancer cells to going from an adherent to less adherent cell type, and commonly associated with metastasis.
records.quote: The process by which cells go from a epithelial to a more mesenchymal from. For cancer cells, this process is linked to going from an adherent to less adherent cell type, and is commonly associated with metastasis.

records.claim: Enhanced permeability and retention is the classical view of nanoparticle delivery to solid tumors.
records.quote: The classical view of nanoparticle delivery to solid tumors, please see Chart 1.

records.claim: An extracellular vesicle is a lipid-coated particle that is naturally shed by a cell and serves as a means of intercellular communication.
records.quote: A lipid-coated particle that is naturally shed by a cell and serves as a means of intercellular communication.

records.claim: Folic acid is a naturally occurring dietary compound (Vitamin B9 in US) whose receptors are commonly overexpressed on many tumor types, making it frequently used as a peptide for targeted NM delivery.
records.quote: A naturally occurring dietary compound (Vitamin B9 in US). Folic acid receptors are commonly overexpressed on many tumor types and folic acid is therefore frequently used as a peptide for targeted NM delivery.

records.claim: The folate receptor is the receptor for folic acid commonly overexpressed on many tumor types and therefore frequently used for targeted NM delivery.
records.quote: The receptor for folic acid commonly overexpressed on many tumor types and therefore frequently used for targeted NM delivery.

records.claim: Fluorouracil is a cytostatic chemotherapeutic agent that inhibits tumor growth, clinically used in colon cancer, esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, pancreatic cancer, breast cancer, and cervical cancer.
records.quote: A cytostatic chemotherapeutic agent that inhibits tumor growth. It is clinically used in colon cancer, esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, pancreatic cancer, breast cancer, and cervical cancer.

records.claim: Glioblastoma multiforme is the most common and highly malignant form of brain tumor.
records.quote: The most common and highly malignant form of brain tumor.

records.claim: Hyaluronic acid is a glycosaminoglycan often present in connective tissue and part of the ECM, which naturally binds CD44 (commonly overexpressed on cancer cells) and is frequently used for targeted NM delivery.
records.quote: A glycosaminoglycan that is often present in connective tissue and makes part of the ECM. It naturally binds CD44, which is commonly overexpressed on cancer cells. Therefore, it is frequently used for targeted NM delivery.

records.claim: Hepatocellular carcinoma is the most common type of primary liver cancer.
records.quote: The most common type of primary liver cancer.

records.claim: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is a cell surface receptor expressed by some, not all, breast or ovarian tumors, and can be targeted directly using Trastuzumab (Herceptin), a clinically approved antibody.
records.quote: Cell surface receptor expressed by some, not all, breast or ovarian tumors. Can be targeted directly using Trastuzumab (Herceptin), a clinically approved antibody.

records.claim: N-(2-Hydroxypropyl) methacrylamide (HPMA) is a monomer that can be used to make polymeric nanoparticles for biomedical use.
records.quote: A monomer that can be used to make polymeric nanoparticles for biomedical use

records.claim: Indocyanine green (ICG) is a near-infrared optical imaging agent with rapid renal clearance, serving as a contrast agent for optical or photoacoustic imaging, and can be used as a photosensitizer in photodynamic or photothermal therapy upon excitation with NIR light.
records.quote: A near-infrared optical imaging agent with rapid renal clearance, can serve as contrast agent for optical or photoacoustic imaging. Can be used as photosensitizer in either photodynamic (ROS generation) or photothermal (temperature increase) therapy upon excitation with NIR light.

records.claim: Interstitial fluid pressure (IFP) is high in tumors due to dense cell mass, poor perfusion, permeable vessels, and poor lymphatic drainage, which hardens the extravasation of NMs from the bloodstream into the tumor tissue.
records.quote: In tumors, the IFP is really high due to a very dense cell mass, poor perfusion, permeable vessels, and very poor lymphatic drainage (fluid outflow). This hardens the extravasation of NMs from the bloodstream against the IFP into the tumor tissue.

records.claim: Microbubbles (MB) are gas-filled bubbles encapsulated by a polymeric or lipid layer that give US contrast, can be tuned for 19F MRI or loaded with therapeutic agents, and release cargo or induce pores via sonoporation.
records.quote: Gas filled bubbles that are encapsulated by a polymeric or lipid layer and gives US contrast. The gas can be tuned to enable 19F MRI, or the MB can be loaded with therapeutic agents on the surface. Via sonoporation (see Chart), they release their cargo or transiently induce pores in blood vessels or cell membranes.

records.claim: Biomimetic cell membrane-coated NPs (MCNPs) are nanomaterials overcoated with biological membranes to avoid immune recognition and clearance.
records.quote: Nanomaterials that are overcoated with biological membranes to avoid immune recognition and clearance.

records.claim: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSC) are myeloid-derived cells with potent immunosuppressive properties that help the tumor to avoid immune clearance.
records.quote: A myeloid derived cell that can be monocytic or granulocytic but which has potent immunosuppressive properties and helps the tumor to avoid immune clearance.

records.claim: Magnetic drug targeting (MDT) is the process by which magnetic fields are used to promote drug delivery to the tissue of interest.
records.quote: The process by which magnetic fields are used to promote drug delivery to the tissue of interest.

records.claim: The major histocompatibility complex (MHC) is a cluster of proteins involved in antigen presentation to T cells, with MHC I present on nearly all cells and MHC II on specialized antigen-presenting cells.
records.quote: A cluster of proteins involved in antigen presentation to T cells. There are 2 main types: MHC I and MHC II. MHC I is present on nearly all cells in the body, MHC II is present on specialized antigen-presenting cells.

records.claim: Magnetic nanocapsules (m-NCs) are NMs that serve as a vessel for transport of therapeutic molecules and contain magnetic NMs for follow-up by imaging or magnetic guidance.
records.quote: A NM that serves as a vessel for transport of therapeutic molecules and also contains magnetic NMs for follow-up by imaging or magnetic guidance.

records.claim: Mitochondrial-targeted multifunctional NMs (MNMs) are NMs that are specifically targeted toward mitochondria.
records.quote: NMs that are specifically targeted toward mitochondria.

records.claim: Magnetic particle imaging (MPI) is a more recent (pre)-clinical noninvasive imaging method that enables sensitive, quantitative and fast imaging of magnetic NMs to study functional parameters.
records.quote: A more recent (pre)-clinical noninvasive imaging method that enables sensitive, quantitative and fast imaging of magnetic NMs to study functional parameters (e.g., inflammation, blood flow, perfusion, cell homing,...).

records.claim: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a (pre)clinical noninvasive imaging method.
records.quote: A (pre)clinical noninvasive imaging method.

records.claim: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) are adult multipotent stem cells isolated from bone marrow, fat, umbilical cord or amniotic fluid, important for making and repairing skeletal tissues.
records.quote: An adult multipotent stem cell that can be isolated from bone marrow, fat, umbilical cord or amniotic fluid and that are important for making and repairing skeletal tissues, such as cartilage, bone, and the fat found in bone marrow.

records.claim: In academic research, the strict EU definition of nanomaterials is not always followed, and polymeric or liposomal particles of around 200 nm diameter are still called nanomaterials.
records.quote: In practice, this definition is not followed very strictly in academic research where polymeric or liposomal particles of around $200\mathrm{nm}$ diameter will still be called a nanomaterial.

records.claim: PEGylation of nanomaterials increases their blood circulation times by reducing immune recognition, opsonisation, and clearance.
records.quote: PEGylation of NMs increases their blood circulation times by reducing immune recognition, opsonisation (see Chart<sup>1</sup>) and clearance.

records.claim: Upon nutrient starvation, Neuropilin-1 (NRP-1) enables a specific endocytosis pathway that can result in direct transcytosis of components from the blood across endothelial cells toward tumor cells.
records.quote: Upon nutrient starvation, they enable a specific endocytosis pathway, which for tumor cells can result in direct transcytosis of components (including NMs) from the blood across the endothelial cells toward the tumor cells.

records.claim: Tirapazamine (TPZ) is an experimental anticancer drug that is only toxic in conditions of hypoxia (low oxygen).
records.quote: TPZ = Tirapazamine: An experimental anticancer drug that is only toxic in conditions of hypoxia (low oxygen).
